title: Structured Output
definition: Model output intended to follow an explicit machine-readable organization.
key_points: A syntactic gate checks that the response can be parsed as the declared representation.
A deterministic invariant gate checks required fields and cross-field relationships.
A semantic acceptance gate requires human judgment about meaning and evidence.

source_support.claim: Structured output follows an explicit machine-readable organization.
source_support.quote: model output intended to follow an explicit machine-readable organization

source_support.claim: A schema cannot prove semantic correctness.
source_support.quote: it cannot prove that the definition accurately represents the source

source_support.claim: Only a separately authorized application operation writes accepted state.
source_support.quote: Only a separately authorized application operation may write accepted state
